title: Thread sources
description: What one worker actually fetched. The merge unions these by canonical URL into sources/registry.json and sources/url-list.json in their existing stage 02/04 shapes, so the fold needs no change to the driver's validators.

id.description: First 8 hex of sha256(canonical_url). Canonicalisation uses the same shared helper as stage 02's dedupe, so the two rules cannot drift.
